subject: RTO/RPO validation and live-witness scheduling for MeridianPay integration
messages:
From: James Liu <james.liu@meridianpay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: soc@meridianpay.com
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + live witness window

Hi Sofia,

Hope you're well. We're preparing MeridianPay's SOC2 assessment and need to validate Redwood's BCP/DR posture for the MeridianPay integration. Specifically, the assessor has asked for:

- A concise RTO/RPO matrix for the services MeridianPay uses (tokenization, inference, embedding store).
- Recent test traces showing warm-cache failover, and any measured restore durations.
- A tabletop summary and the ability to schedule a live witness (we expect a 60–90 minute window) where ops runs a controlled failover.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts and propose two possible dates/times for a live witness next week (UTC)? Also please include who from Redwood would attend (ops & infra).

Thanks,
James
James Liu
Security & Controls Lead
MeridianPay

[Attachment: meridian_request_scope.pdf]

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@meridianpay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-19T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + live witness window

Hi James — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the RTO/RPO matrix and recent traces. Attached is an initial BCP matrix (meridian_bcp_matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps services to recovery targets and owners.

Proposed live-witness windows (UTC):
- Option A: Tue 2027-02-22 14:00–15:30 UTC
- Option B: Thu 2027-02-24 15:00–16:30 UTC

Redwood attendees we plan to include: Ben Carter (Sr. Ops Engineer), Marissa Cole (Customer Reliability), and I will run coordination. If you prefer, Priya Natarajan (Security Ops) can join the tabletop portion.

We ran a warm-cache failover on 2027-02-20; extracts and traces are in rto_rpo_test-traces_20270220.zip (attached). I'll follow up with a brief tabletop summary and a proposed script for the witness run to minimize customer impact.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: meridian_bcp_matrix_v1.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, James Liu <james.liu@meridianpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + live witness window

Adding the ops detail here. Summary of the 2027-02-20 warm-cache exercise:

- Trigger: simulated node termination in eu-west-1 (autoscaling group drain + KV cache rebuild).
- Observed token-serving degradation window: 00:48–02:05 UTC (1h17m) to reach steady-state under the simulated load profile.
- Rolling warm-cache rebuilds completed per shard; failover handover to cold-variant (quantized model) lasted ~2m for streaming endpoints.
- Artifacts: consolidated logs and trace snapshots included in rto_rpo_test-traces_20270220.zip. The zip has op-trace-*.log and restore-metrics.csv.

Notes / mitigation: we can shorten observed windows by increasing pre-warm cache keepalive (recommendation in the matrix). We'll include config snippets in the tabletop script.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rto_rpo_test-traces_20270220.zip]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@meridianpay.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-22T09:14:00Z
Subject: Tabletop summary + proposed witness script

Hi all,

Attached is the tabletop-summary-meridian-20270222.pdf — this is a short (~4 page) narrative of the tabletop we ran internally and the step-by-step script we propose for the live witness. Highlights:

- Run length: ~60 mins (setup + controlled failover + validation).
- Impact surface: tokenization endpoint throttle for <5% of requests for ~5 minutes during handover (we'll throttle test clients only).
- Validation checklist: 1) failover trigger confirmation, 2) KV cache rebuild metrics capture, 3) end-to-end inference correctness sample (5 requests), 4) rollback path tested.

Availability: we can support either of the proposed windows but prefer Thu 2027-02-24 15:00–16:30 UTC so we have time to incorporate the trace annotations.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: tabletop-summary-meridian-20270222.pdf]

From: James Liu <james.liu@meridianpay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-24T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Tabletop summary + proposed witness script

Thanks Sofia/Marissa/Ben — Thu 2027-02-24 15:00–16:30 UTC works for us. Please confirm the final attendee list (names + roles) and whether Redwood will record the validation traces to share post-run. Also, can you provide a short spreadsheet with personnel escalation contacts for the run (on-call, tech lead, security contact)?

We'll invite our assessor and SOC rep to observe. Confirming scope: controlled failover only — no production traffic will be routed to MeridianPay test clients.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
James
James Liu
Security & Controls Lead
MeridianPay
